Hi Neha / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Lumen is keen to run an 8-week evaluation targeting our clinical summarization workflow. Before we lock dates, procurement asked for a clear MAP with checkpoint approvals tied to pricing tiers — they want to understand what discounts/commits we can expect as usage ramps.

High level:
- 2-week pilot (sandbox) for integration validation
- 30-day canary (limited production) with 100k tokens/month baseline
- 90-day ramp to 750k tokens/month if metrics pass

Can you share a staircase pricing idea (commits -> discounts -> milestone acceptance criteria) and a simple MAP PDF we can take to procurement this week? Budget owner needs a rough PO figure.

Aisha

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear outline.

We're drafting a MAP that maps the pilot->canary->ramp checkpoints to concrete acceptance criteria and pricing bands. Initial thoughts (high level):
- Pilot (0–2 weeks): free sandbox access, integration support, up to 10k tokens/day for test flows.
- Canary (day 14–45): baseline commit 100k tokens/mo; discounted unit price at 10% off list if latency/quality SLOs met for 3 consecutive weeks.
- Ramp (month 2–4): commit tiers: 250k / 500k / 750k; additional discounts unlocked at 30%/40%/50% off list at each tier subject to sustained throughput and quality gates.

I'll attach a first draft stair-step pricing workbook and a short MAP timeline PDF for procurement review. Ben / Dev — flagged for pricing and capacity notes.

Next steps: I can send the version to procurement for initial signoff and loop in your security contact if needed. Do you have a target PO amount (ballpark) that procurement expects?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Neha / Dev —

Quick internal notes before we send to procurement:
- Recommend tightening the canary acceptance: require both latency < 250ms p95 and ROUGE/semantic fidelity threshold (we have eval harness ready).
- Adjusted discounts: 100k baseline -> 12% off; 250k -> 28% off; 500k -> 38% off; 750k -> 48% off. Keep a top-end cap and give Lumen an early-adopter credit of $10k if they sign within 30 days.
- Suggest a credit tranche that vests at each MAP checkpoint rather than a single upfront credit — easier for finance and aligns incentives.

I'll attach an adjusted pricing workbook for Neha to share.

Ben
Sr. Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
